articles.title: Stream It Or Skip It: ‘A Big Bold Beautiful Journey’ on Netflix, a Thunderous Dud of a High-Concept Romance, Starring Margot Robbie and Colin Farrell
articles.summary: The article discusses "A Big Bold Beautiful Journey," now streaming on Netflix, highlighting it as one of 2025's most significant creative and commercial failures. Despite the involvement of acclaimed talent, including director Kogonada, the film reportedly failed to live up to expectations, underscoring that even promising collaborations can result in critical and box-office disappointments on a global platform.

During his interview, Chandler was also questioned about future professional endeavors. While details on his upcoming projects were not specified in this report, the discussion primarily focused on his current cinematic work, offering insights into his ongoing career.

articles.title: NATO’s Suez moment: The Greenland drama shows the US will no longer be Europe’s guarantor
articles.summary: The Spectator's headline posits a 'Greenland drama' as NATO's 'Suez moment,' indicating a significant shift where the United States will no longer serve as Europe's primary security guarantor. This suggests a major recalibration of transatlantic defence relations, compelling Europe to assume greater responsibility for its strategic independence and security.

articles.title: Russia Is ‘Without Question’ a Threat in the Arctic, Carney Says
articles.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney alerted world leaders in Davos about a "clear threat" posed by Russia in the Arctic. He specified this threat is currently more prospective than actual. This highlights increasing geopolitical concerns over the Arctic's strategic importance and Russia's growing military activities, underscoring future international security challenges pertinent for defence aspirants.

articles.title: LG Ladakh declares open 6th Khelo India Winter Games in Leh
articles.summary: Lt Governor Kavinder Gupta inaugurated the 6th Khelo India Winter Games 2026 in Leh, Ladakh, at the state-of-the-art NDS ice hockey stadium. This significant national event promotes winter sports, youth participation, and sports infrastructure development in the region. It highlights India's commitment to nurturing athletic talent and fostering national integration through sports, particularly in challenging terrains like Ladakh.

articles.title: Turkey probing flag burning at protests along Syrian border
articles.summary: Turkey is investigating its flag's burning by pro-Kurdish groups during protests along its Syrian border, coinciding with clashes. This incident underscores the significant and ongoing tensions in the region, reflecting complex geopolitical dynamics. It highlights critical national security challenges for Turkey, involving pro-Kurdish factions and cross-border instability.
